page.overview:
Who is The Grey Lady?

Sister Elara, also known as The Grey Lady, was a deserter of the Bene Gesserit.

Sister Elara a sister of the Bene Gesserit who was renowned for her abilities as a Truthsayer. She was expelled from the Sisterhood for unknown reasons after she challenged the Reverend Mothers. The Sisterhood ordered a manhunt to retrieve her and she went into hiding. Relocating to Arrakis, she established the largest brothel in the sector. She was later arrested on suspiscion of witchcraft.

Elara was later chosen to compete in the Harkonnen Family Games alongside Amado Delsin, Hollow Tom, Kaylen Shiff, an unnamed Fremen, Poyko Nen, the Morani Twins and Kanto. They were placed in the Grand Arena, which had been made into a labyrinth. Once the competition began, she entered the Shadow Corridor, where she dispatched a group of poison-spitting creatures with ease. She later encountered Nen, who attacked her and tore off her veil, revealing her scarred and disfigured face. She fled as Kanto arrived and his rock lizards tore Nen apart. She lost Kanto's pursuit and was cornered by the twins, at which point she used the Voice to order them to kill each other.

She reached the innermost chamber of the labyrinth before the Fremen, becoming trapped inside with a Laza tiger. She used the Voice to order it to stand down, but the beast attacked her. The Fremen then entered and the tiger attacked him and he killed it with his crysknife, though the tiger tore off one of his arms before dying. Taking advantage of his wounded state, Elara ordered him to kill himself with the Voice. All of her opponents now dead, Elara rose to her feet and pressed the Conqueror's Seal, winning the game.
